description: A Submarine Landslides Database of Calabrian Continental Margins (Central Mediterranean Sea) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Marco Bianchini et al. Submarine landslides are complex and widespread natural events occurring all over the world, in every latitude and depth. Understanding the genesis and evolution of submarine landslides requires interpreting the nature of the seafloor, on which these landslides occur. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Shapefile, GeoPackage, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
